findings.title: U.S. food insecurity remains elevated after pandemic support changes
findings.falsifier: A later comparable release that reverses the stated mechanism would falsify the candidate.
findings.next_action: Align USDA and Urban definitions, preserve the methodology break, and acquire the next comparable release before any monitored state or internal bridge.

findings.title: Digital capability expands while control and trust remain contested
findings.falsifier: If capability adoption repeatedly coincides with stronger control, remedy, and trust outcomes across independent measures, the contested-control claim is weakened.
findings.next_action: Separate efficiency, delegation, trust, control, recourse, retention, and exit measures.

findings.title: Formal response arrives before usable recovery
findings.falsifier: If comparable cases repeatedly show usable recovery before formal response, or formal response without durable access improvement, the sequence claim is weakened.
findings.next_action: Code formal response, implementation, receipt, durable access, and exit stages across independent labor, consumer, health, and public-service records.

findings.title: Infrastructure dependency becomes cultural and geopolitical power
findings.falsifier: If comparable infrastructure events show no durable reliability, cost, compensation, or acceptance consequence, the dependency-to-power mechanism is weakened.
findings.next_action: Link capacity or ownership claims to operation, actual receipt, local burden, maintenance, and acceptance.

findings.title: Time and financial pressure reduce practical room before demand disappears
findings.falsifier: If compatible repeated measures show pressure rising without reduced participation, substitution, or delayed completion, the practical-room mechanism is weakened.
findings.next_action: Preserve compatible time, cost, participation, and wellbeing units before interpreting practical-room change.
